migration_objective: Replace RSA issuer key generation with ML-DSA-65 and update public-key provisioning.
preconditions: Events, holders, and pass records are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Offline verifiers accept active, correctly signed, unexpired passes.
Expired, revoked, malformed, or modified pass evidence is rejected.
migration_requirements: Use standardized ML-DSA-65 through the pinned provider.
Update offline public-key distribution and signature persistence.
No classical fallback; retain credential context binding.
verification_procedure: Run original and reference test modules separately.
Test valid, altered, wrong-key, expired, revoked, malformed-key, duplicate-serial, and serialization cases.
known_limitations: Offline revocation is only as fresh as the verifier snapshot.
